'''
Interfaces for the google-images-download package.

This module defines duck-typed interfaces to enable loose coupling between
components during the decomposition of the monolithic `googleimagesdownload`
class. It is intentionally minimal and non-intrusive.
'''


class SearchStrategy(object):
    """
    Duck-typed interface for building search URLs and extracting tabs.
    Any class implementing these methods can be used as a search strategy.
    """
    def build_search_url(self, args):
        """Build a Google Images search URL from parsed arguments."""
        raise NotImplementedError

    def build_url_parameters(self, args):
        """Extract URL query parameters from args."""
        raise NotImplementedError

    def get_all_tabs(self, page, keywords):
        """Extract related search tabs from a page."""
        raise NotImplementedError


class Downloader(object):
    """
    Duck-typed interface for downloading image content.
    Any class implementing these methods can be used as a downloader.
    """
    def download_image(self, img_url, request_header, output_directory, image_filename, delay=0):
        """Download a single image from the given URL."""
        raise NotImplementedError

    def download_thumbnail(self, thumb_url, request_header, output_directory, image_filename):
        """Download a thumbnail image."""
        raise NotImplementedError


class PageFetcher(object):
    """
    Duck-typed interface for fetching HTML pages.
    Any class implementing these methods can be used as a page fetcher.
    """
    def fetch(self, url, timeout=None):
        """Fetch raw HTML page content as a string."""
        raise NotImplementedError

    def fetch_extended(self, url, chromedriver_path, timeout=None):
        """Fetch extended page content using Selenium (e.g., scroll more)."""
        raise NotImplementedError


class PathBuilder(object):
    """
    Duck-typed interface for building output paths.
    Any class implementing these methods can be used as a path builder.
    """
    def build_output_directory(self, base_dir, sub_dir, keywords):
        """Build the full output directory path."""
        raise NotImplementedError

    def sanitize_filename(self, filename, prefix=None, number=None):
        """Sanitize a filename for safe storage."""
        raise NotImplementedError
